clips.title: The story
paras: Uzzek watches the eastern Barrens from southwest of Far Watch Post. The battle-hardened orc survived many skirmishes across Kalimdor and now tests and trains promising Horde warriors crossing the plains.

Uzzek trains young warriors southwest of Far Watch Post, near the eastern edge of the Barrens. He endured brutal combat in the recent wars and now tests those learning to defend themselves. To prove their skill, they face the savage wildlife and raiders that trouble the crossing.
